examples.translation: The product turns into a commodity, not because it was produced by a capitalist, feudal lord or slaveowner on the basis of exploitation or a small producer on the basis of personal labor, but because the various production units are isolated from each other on the basis of the social division of labor and the connection between them can be carried out only through commodity exchange.
